title: Native American Religion and Cosmology
description: This course examines Native American religions and conceptions of soul, cosmos, witchcraft, curing, dreaming, and psychoactive plants across space and time, from the Arctic to the Aztecs to the Amazon. By exploring indigenous understandings of the nature of reality and ways of knowing about it, students develop an empathetic awareness of the contours of Native universes and analyze how religious ideas are mobilized within the socio-political dynamics that shape indigenous lives in modern nation-states.
